messages.author: 1bf1f4e89a80d1cf
messages.subject: Binomial Spatio-temporal model won't fit
parts:
I am trying to fit an spde spatio-temporal model with binomial response data. Its large spatial data (continental scale) with the mesh varying across the year with a cyclic ar1 structure. I can get the model to fit with a mesh that has fairly large triangles (max edge for the internal triangles=3) and coarse temporal structure (k=12). However, if I try to make either component finer (e.g., max edge=0.5 or k=52) the model crashes without giving a specific error. Running with verbose=T doesn't show any obvious warnings. I have already played round with the priors a lot along with triangle shapes, etc.

I am wondering if the problem could be complete separation? The proportion of positive cases varies throughout the year, reaching a peak of about 30% positive cases in the fall, but falling to near 0 in the spring. Could this be the reason I can't make either the spatial or temporal mesh too fine and still get the model to fit?
